final_justification: The CSR-write suppression control directly forces operations to READ; a fault can create or suppress an internal CSR write.
The misalignment exception suppresses or redirects writeback; a fault can therefore create or remove an internal CSR write.
The core CSR operation code directly qualifies csr_we_int and exhibited near-unity joint fault susceptibility.
The decoder's CSR classification feeds the write-enable chain and showed high feasibility with limited masking.
This qualified decode-stage operation is captured into the ID/EX pipeline; a fault can convert a read into a write before commit.
ID readiness controls pipeline acceptance of the CSR operation; faults propagated strongly to csr_we_int.
Execution readiness controls CSR instruction advance and can mis-time or suppress the internal write enable.
